description: This Java class 'ProductFiles' acts as a data transfer object (DTO) for handling product file upload forms in the shop admin interface. It encapsulates uploaded files, associated digital product data, and the product itself, with validation annotations for ensuring correct form data.

classes.name: ProductFiles
classes.description: A bean class responsible for capturing form data related to uploading digital product files in the shop admin panel, including uploaded files, associated digital product, and product details.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Returns the list of uploaded multipart files with validation annotations enforcing non-emptiness.

methods.name: setFile
methods.description: Sets the list of uploaded files.
